items.title: ZDI-CAN-28490: Linux
items.description: A CVSS score 7.5 AV:L/AC:H/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Maher Azzouzi (@maherazz2)' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2025-11-18, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-03-18 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
